name: Big Bad Boss of The Malt Shop
source:
Novelty restaurants are all the rage nowadays, and there isn't a stronger experience than the sweet thrill of nostalgia. Some would think the echoes of the 80s in the menu and furnishing are more than enough, but to you, not so much.

See, you enjoy the thrill of that age... and the men that brought that danger, especially if it means getting to tame one particularly rowdy wolf.

[From [url=https://foxglove-vn-productions.itch.io/big-bad-boss-of-the-malt-shop]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如今，新奇的餐厅非常流行，没有什么比怀旧的甜蜜刺激更强烈的体验了。有些人可能认为菜单和陈设中的80年代风格已经足够了，但对你来说，还不够。

看，你享受那个时代的刺激……以及那些带来危险的人，特别是如果这意味着要驯服一只特别吵闹的狼。

[来自[url=https://foxglove-vn-productions.itch.io/big-bad-boss-of-the-malt-shop]Itch.io[/url]]
